_comment: Static (s,t,d) router table for Qwen3-8B-vega EAGLE3, from eagle3_brute_best_by_c.json. Keys are the LOWER edge of each batch-size bucket; routing picks the largest key <= live batch size. Each entry is the brute-force-optimal (num_steps, eagle_topk, num_draft_tokens) for that concurrency range.
